scripts.db:reset: rm -rf .wrangler/state && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.db:migrate:prod: wrangler d1 migrations apply myanimalroom-feedback --remote --config wrangler.production.jsonc
scripts.stats: wrangler d1 execute myanimalroom-feedback --remote --config wrangler.production.jsonc --command "SELECT source, campaign, SUM(CASE WHEN kind='visit' THEN count END) AS visits, SUM(CASE WHEN store='app' THEN count END) AS app_taps, SUM(CASE WHEN store='play' THEN count END) AS play_taps FROM site_stats WHERE day >= date('now', '-30 days') GROUP BY source, campaign ORDER BY visits DESC"
